## Summary

I investigated ticket T-2007 regarding the inventory-db pod restarting after a node reboot. The pod logs showed PostgreSQL database corruption with "invalid primary checkpoint record" errors, preventing the database from starting. This is a critical issue that requires expert handling since PostgreSQL recovery procedures (like pg_resetwal) could result in data loss. I escalated the ticket to a human engineer, noting that a backup exists (inventory-backup-29637180-w2hcd) but the recovery strategy requires human judgment on whether to restore from backup or attempt database recovery.
